tasks.short: Record exact artifact locations and conditions with drawings and photographs

steps.what: Measure and capture the actual artifact location, survey reference, context and observed condition at the site
inputs: Actual uncovered artifact and site context
Existing survey instrument and field recording system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual captured coordinates with reference system, context identifier and human condition observations

steps.what: Make the actual required drawings and photographs, identifying the artifact, scale, orientation and context
inputs: Actual artifact and field references from s1
Existing camera and drawing tools
outputs: Actual identified drawings and photographs with captured associations

steps.what: Import exact captured coordinates, condition entries and selected image references into the native artifact record
inputs: Actual captured fields and survey reference from s1
Actual selected drawings and photograph associations from s2
outputs: Draft artifact record with exact source-linked fields and image references

steps.what: Complete and check the entire final artifact record against field observations, coordinate reference, images and drawings
inputs: Draft artifact record and all actual source material from s1-s2
outputs: Exact complete checked record including uncertainties and missing information

steps.what: Commit the exact checked final artifact location and condition record
inputs: Exact completed record checked in s4
outputs: Saved artifact record with actual source references

tasks.design: Configure the native {OTHER} field-record import for exact survey fields and the worker-selected drawing and photograph references. Keep actual measurements, condition observations, drawings, photographs and the complete final record check human.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manual artifact record can require re-entry of already captured survey fields and image references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import mappings can carry exact captured fields into a draft record with source references.
tasks.still_hard: Exact context and condition must be observed before the artifact is moved or its surroundings change.
tasks.human_edge: Identify ambiguity, survey-reference errors and an image that does not document the actual context.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: field recording systems can import explicit survey coordinates and selected media references; they cannot invent missing artifact context or physical condition observations.

assumptions: This conditional workflow has an actual manually repeated field-to-record transfer; shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the supplied prior.

The focal worker produces and captures all coordinates, context identifiers, reference systems and condition text in s1, and actual drawings, photos and their associations in s2. No free structured survey or automatically interpreted condition feed is assumed.
Try native field recording import first. Existing automatic capture or import is baseline and earns no additional saving; unattended instrument or upload runtime is not labour.
Missing coordinates, unclear reference systems or mismatched media stop import for manual resolution in retained work. No model infers a location, condition, date or association.
The complete actual record is checked before the separate negligible save, which earns no saving. No public site-location release or external send is included.
unknowns: Actual field-to-record transfer effort and survey export compatibility
research_questions: Observe actual recording and verify that coordinate reference and artifact-to-photo associations survive a trial import.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final artifact record checked in s4 against actual field sources; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross saving=25. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 22. Physical capture, complete checking and the negligible save remain fully retained.

tasks.short: Assess archaeological sites and recommend protection methods

steps.what: Locate and read the actual site records, development or conservation proposal and applicable assessment brief
inputs: Actual site records and proposal
Existing site-record and map system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual source set and understood assessment scope

steps.what: Assess the actual site evidence, condition, significance and effects of the proposed activity
inputs: Actual site and sources located in s1
outputs: Human assessment of site significance, condition, risks and uncertainties

steps.what: Determine feasible site-protection recommendations from the actual assessment and management purpose
inputs: Actual assessment and uncertainties from s2
outputs: Human-selected protection methods, reasons and limits

steps.what: Write the actual assessment and protection recommendation, reusing exact site identifiers and selected source fields in the native template
inputs: Actual conclusions from s2-s3
Selected exact source fields captured while reading in s1
outputs: Complete human-authored assessment and recommendation draft

steps.what: Check the entire final assessment and recommendations against the actual evidence, scope and stated uncertainties
inputs: Complete actual document from s4 and original sources
outputs: Exact checked final assessment document

steps.what: Save the exact checked assessment and protection recommendations
inputs: Exact complete final document checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual assessment and recommendations

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} source views and exact site fields in the {DOCS} assessment template. Keep actual assessment, protection choices, substantive recommendation writing and the complete final evidence check human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the relevant site record and repeating its exact identifiers can interrupt assessment writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed site views and linked template fields can reuse specific verified records.
tasks.still_hard: Site significance and proportionate protection depend on evidence and competing management needs.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a particular protection method fits the actual site and proposed activity.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed site records and document templates can reduce exact lookup and field copying without determining archaeological significance or protection policy.

assumptions: This illustrative written-assessment episode includes actual site assessment and the actual recommendation record; shares are not observed baselines or prompt time priors.

Only locating existing sources is reduced in s1; substantive reading, capturing selected fields and resolving unavailable evidence remain. No free digitisation or applicable legal requirement set is assumed.
Only exact fixed-field reuse reduces s4; actual reasons and recommendation wording remain human. Native views or fields already in use are baseline and earn no new gain.

The final assessment exists before s5. Save is a separate negligible retained action. This is a saved recommendation, not an enacted protection measure, permit determination or silently issued external report; actual issue requires its own final-version gate and send.
unknowns: Actual record accessibility and required assessment issue process
research_questions: Which exact lookup and fixed-field copying steps occur in an observed site assessment?

already_counted.description: Remaining source work, actual assessment, protection decisions, writing and full final check remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain site-view and template mappings and review source version exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact entire assessment and recommendations checked in s5; edits invalidate the check.

tasks.short: Gather and analyse artifacts and skeletal remains to understand ancient cultures

steps.what: Verify the actual collection scope, access authority, context and handling conditions for gathering the identified material
inputs: Actual identified material and context
Existing authorised collection plan and handling instructions
outputs: Verified current readiness for this specific gathering operation, or a stop

steps.what: Gather the actual artifacts or skeletal remains using the authorised method and capture their actual context and associations
inputs: Exact material and operation checked in s1
outputs: Actually gathered material with captured context and handling observations

steps.what: Examine and analyse the actual material and context to determine supported cultural findings and uncertainties
inputs: Actual gathered material and context from s2
Existing analysis tools and collection catalogue, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human analysis, observations, supported findings and uncertainties

steps.what: Write and check the actual findings record, reusing exact worker-selected collection identifiers in the native template
inputs: Actual findings from s3
Exact collection identifiers and context captured in s2
outputs: Complete final findings record checked for actual meaning, provenance and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the exact complete checked findings record
inputs: Exact final record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual analysis record

tasks.design: Retain actual collection, examination and cultural interpretation, using native {DOCS} fields only for exact identifiers already captured in {OTHER}. Write and check the actual findings after the material has been analysed, then save the exact checked record.
tasks.previous_blocker: A findings record may repeat identifiers already captured with the gathered material.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record fields can reuse exact selected collection identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Provenance, context and cultural interpretation cannot be supplied by a model when the evidence is missing.
tasks.human_edge: Handle the actual material and distinguish observation from inference.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collection templates can reuse exact identifiers but do not replace physical gathering, context capture or archaeological interpretation.

assumptions: This is an illustrative authorised gathering-and-analysis episode with an actual findings record; it is not a measured baseline or a universal mix of all analysis methods.

Ordinary access and specific handling readiness are checked in s1, not invented new permissions. Changed material, context or method requires renewed checking before s2. No new destructive test or laboratory procedure is introduced.

Actual context and source identifiers are produced and captured in s2, and all actual analysis and substantive writing remain in s3-s4. No free classified collection or inferred ancestry, date or cultural label is assumed.
Native fields are tried first; already configured identifier reuse is baseline. Save is negligible and earns no gain. No hidden publication, sample transfer or external report send is included.
Where the same location or collection entry is also counted under 22238, deduplicate its actual capture and record rather than claiming two gains.
unknowns: Actual collection authority and which findings fields are manually repeated
research_questions: What exact existing record follows the actual gathering and analysis episode?

already_counted.description: Actual handling readiness and complete findings writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain identifier mappings and check provenance-field exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact material, context and gathering operation checked for current authority and handling readiness in s1; any change requires a fresh check.
Exact complete final findings record checked in s4 after the actual analysis.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=98.1; gross saving=1.9 from exact identifier reuse only. Deduct 1 incremental hour once for net 0.9. Gathering, analysis, full meaning check and save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare site findings with archaeological data from other sites

steps.what: Locate, read and verify the actual site findings and comparison datasets, capturing selected records, provenance and explicit unit and category mappings
inputs: Actual own-site findings and available other-site archaeological records
Existing archaeological data and analysis system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human-selected actual records, checked provenance, explicit mappings and selected descriptive comparisons

steps.what: Import the exact selected records into the native comparison table using only the explicit mappings captured by the researcher
inputs: Actual selected source records and explicit mappings from s1
outputs: Draft source-linked comparison table with unmatched fields exposed

steps.what: Calculate the researcher-selected exact descriptive counts and cross-site comparisons from the mapped records
inputs: Mapped records from s2
Explicit selected counts, units and comparison rules from s1
outputs: Draft reproducible comparison tables with missing and unmatched values exposed

steps.what: Examine the actual tables and source records to identify supported similarities and differences and judge contextual comparability
inputs: Actual source-linked comparisons and original site records
outputs: Human comparative interpretation, limits and unresolved inconsistencies

steps.what: Write and check the complete actual comparison findings against source provenance, units, context and uncertainty
inputs: Actual interpretation from s4 and original sources and tables
outputs: Exact complete checked comparison findings record

steps.what: Save the exact checked site-comparison findings record
inputs: Exact final findings checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual cross-site findings

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} imports and exact descriptive comparison tables from records and mappings selected and captured by the researcher. Keep provenance assessment, contextual comparability, archaeological interpretation and the actual final findings record human in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual comparative analysis can spend effort re-entering selected records and manually constructing descriptive tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and explicit table calculations can reproduce the selected comparisons without semantic classification.
tasks.still_hard: Similar counts do not establish comparable contexts, dates, recovery methods or cultural meanings.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an apparent cross-site difference reflects the material, recovery method or an incompatible record.

ambition.what: Re-run selected descriptive comparisons after verified source corrections.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native data imports and explicit descriptive calculations can reproduce selected cross-site tables while contextual comparability and archaeological interpretation remain human.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manually assembled comparative tables. Shares are provisional, not measured or sized to the prompt prior; do not extrapolate to comparisons performed solely by reading.

The researcher locates and reads actual sources, captures their selected records and explicitly defines categories, units and calculations in s1. No free clean inter-site dataset or model-created compatibility mapping is assumed.
Unmapped categories and unknown provenance remain exposed and stop the affected comparison for retained manual resolution. No model infers cultural labels, chronology or missing measurements.
Try existing native analysis imports and tables first. Existing scripts, imports, calculations and unattended runtime are baseline and earn no new saving.

All substantive comparison and actual findings writing stay human. The complete record is checked before the negligible separate save. No publication or external send occurs here; deduplicate shared own-site records against 22238 and 22240 if the same actual work is used.
unknowns: Actual format compatibility and proportion of manually assembled tables
research_questions: Can an observed cross-site comparison be reproduced exactly, including missing values and incompatible categories?

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete comparative findings checked against original records and context in s5; edits invalidate the check.
